_comment: Per-consumer governance (captain decision D4, 2026-08-26): one entry per
LiteLLM virtual key. provision_keys.py (helm hook + 15m CronJob in
helmrelease.yaml) reads this file and mints/updates a virtual key via the
/key API - LiteLLM has no config-file-only way to declare a budgeted key,
the provisioning Job is stdlib-only Python with no PyYAML dependency.
To add a consumer: add an entry to `consumers` below, add a matching
commit. The provision-keys-sync CronJob (every 15m) re-reads this file
and is idempotent: an existing key keeps its value, only its
budget/rate-limit/model-list are re-synced. A Helm install/upgrade hook
also runs the same script immediately on first deploy.
To raise a budget later: edit the numbers below and commit. The existing
key is preserved (see previous line); only its limits change.

consumers.name: demo
consumers._comment: D4: 'create a tiny budget first we will expand later.' Small enough to exhaust in one manual smoke test.
